description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans project, focusing on testing the implementation of IStateMachineStorageProvider with Azure Blob Storage and in-memory storage. It defines test classes for different storage backends, a base class with common test logic for list operations, and various test methods to validate persistence, correctness, and recovery of list-like data structures in a distributed system.

classes.name: AzureStorageLogSegmentTests
classes.description: Test class for Azure Blob Storage-based list segment storage, inheriting from LogSegmentTests and configuring Azure storage options.

classes.name: InMemoryLogSegmentTests
classes.description: Test class for in-memory storage implementation of IStateMachineStorageProvider.

classes.name: LogSegmentTests
classes.description: Abstract base class containing common setup, initialization, disposal, and test methods for validating storage providers and list operations.

classes.name: TestPerson
classes.description: Data class representing a person, used for testing persistence of complex types.

classes.name: TestGrainContext
classes.description: Mock implementation of IGrainContext used to provide context for tests involving GrainId.

methods.name: AzureStorageLogSegmentTests
methods.description: Constructor that invokes precondition checks and sets up Azure storage configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Configures dependency injection services for Azure storage provider tests.

methods.name: InMemoryLogSegmentTests
methods.description: Configures in-memory storage provider for tests.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up dependency injection and initializes the test environment before each test.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources after each test.

methods.name: CreateTestComponents
methods.description: Creates and initializes list management components with specified grain ID and storage provider.

methods.name: DurableList_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests adding, updating, and removing items from the list and ensures persistence across state writes.

methods.name: DurableList_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that list state persists and can be recovered by creating a new list backed by the same storage.

methods.name: DurableList_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving complex objects and mutable types, checking for correct serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: DurableList_Clear_Test
methods.description: Ensures that clearing a list persists correctly and results in an empty list after reload.

methods.name: DurableList_Contains_Test
methods.description: Validates that containment checks and removal by value work as expected.

methods.name: DurableList_InsertAndRemove_Test
methods.description: Tests insertion at specific index and removal, validating list integrity.

methods.name: DurableList_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Checks that enumeration and list iteration behave correctly.

methods.name: DurableList_LargeNumberOfOperations_And_Snapshot_Test
methods.description: Performs large scale operations to test performance, snapshotting, and recovery of the list.
